title: V3 Diff protection configuration
description: Paths whose deletion or rename the Diff stage rejects, and the directory of authorization records that a verified change may consume (Plan 06 P3.2, D20). Entries ending in / protect a directory prefix; other entries protect one exact path; matching ignores case.

authorizationDirectory.description: Repository-relative directory of change-trusted-base records; it should itself be protected.
